name: Language
description: Represents a content language used in Sitecore.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: A human readable name of the language.

fields.name: englishName
fields.description: Gets the culture name in the format languagefull [country/regionfull] in English.

fields.name: iso
fields.description: The Two Letter ISO code of the language.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The culture name in the languagecode2-country/regioncode2 format.

fields.name: nativeName
fields.description: The culture name, consisting of the language, the country/region, and the optional script, that the culture is set to display.
